module: 'Locations' sub-editor of the sites editor. The module returns a class constructor C (called with sitesEditor and the key 'locations'). It handles selection, the click test (sphere of radius node.radius), the translation and scale gizmo (the location's radius), creation and deletion with undoable history (editor.history). It is used with sortedListDisplay as the element editor.
notes: The minimum radius of a location is 0.1 (math.max(0.1, ...)).
In drawElement, the 'Closest Road' text displays the two nodes returned by map.findClosestRoad.

C.desc: Object returned by the module constructor. Fields: sitesEditor, key, current (selected location), sites, list.

init.desc: Constructor (called by the module): stores sitesEditor and the key, with no selection.

setSites.desc: Sets the edited sites, keeps the list sites[key] and deselects.

select.desc: Selects a location and places the gizmo on it.

hitTest.desc: Returns the location closest to the camera whose sphere (radius node.radius) is crossed by the mouse ray.

mouseInfo.desc: Mouse info (camPos, rayDir) built by sitesEditor.

updateTransform.desc: Places the gizmo on the position of the current location.

beginDrag.desc: Start of a gizmo drag: stores the starting position and radius.

dragging.desc: During the drag: in translation mode updates pos, in scale mode recomputes radius (minimum 0.1) from the gizmo factor.

endDragging.desc: End of drag: records an undoable action 'Update Transform of ...' (old and new pos/radius).

create.desc: Creates a location at the given position (undoable action 'Create Location') and returns it.

drawElement.desc: Draws the element editor: gizmo (if allowGizmo) and the text of the closest road segment.
